name: tang-pai-nai-api
description: Tang Pai Nai — personal income / expense tracker REST API

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc-alias -p tsconfig.build.json --resolve-full-paths && npm run copy-assets

scripts-info.start: Runs the compiled application in production mode using environment variables.
scripts-info.dev: Starts the development server with hot-reload (tsx) and development environment.
scripts-info.fix: Automatically fixes linting issues and formats code with Prettier.
scripts-info.lint: Checks the codebase with ESLint without modifying files (used by CI).
scripts-info.typecheck: Type-checks src, including test files, with tsc without emitting output (used by CI).
scripts-info.clean: Removes the dist directory for a fresh build.
scripts-info.build: Compiles TypeScript to JavaScript, resolves path aliases, and copies OpenAPI spec assets.
scripts-info.copy-assets: Copies the OpenAPI YAML spec tree into dist/ (not handled by tsc).
scripts-info.db:generate: Generates a SQL migration in drizzle/ from changes in src/core/database/schema/.
scripts-info.db:seed: Inserts dev data (idempotent; skipped in production).
scripts-info.db:studio: Opens Drizzle Studio to browse the database (loads .env.dev).
scripts-info.sync:cleanup: Deletes tombstones and sync op records older than 90 days and raises the purge watermark (loads .env.dev).
scripts-info.auth:cleanup: Deletes auth challenges, sessions and rate-limit buckets that ended over 7 days ago (loads .env.dev).
scripts-info.dev:oidc: Runs a local stand-in for Google's OpenID Connect provider on :4400 (dev and manual tests only).
scripts-info.test:watch: Runs the test suite in watch mode (Vitest).

author: Dryst
